mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM oag_domains WHERE domain = #{domain} AND enabled = 1

SELECT a.object_type AS objectType, a.object_id AS objectId, o.object_name AS objectName, o.aliases_json AS aliasesJson, o.params_json AS paramsJson, MAX( CASE WHEN a.normalized_alias = #{normalized} THEN 1.0 WHEN #{normalized} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.normalized_alias, '%') THEN 0.86 WHEN #{question} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.alias, '%') THEN 0.82 ELSE 0.65 END ) AS score FROM oag_object_aliases a JOIN oag_objects o ON o.domain = a.domain AND o.object_type = a.object_type AND o.object_id = a.object_id WHERE a.domain = #{domain} AND ( a.normalized_alias = #{normalized} OR #{normalized} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.normalized_alias, '%') OR #{question} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.alias, '%') ) GROUP BY a.object_type, a.object_id, o.object_name, o.aliases_json, o.params_json ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT attr.object_type AS objectType, a.attribute_name AS attributeName, attr.attribute_name_zh AS attributeNameZh, attr.aliases_json AS aliasesJson, MAX( CASE WHEN a.normalized_alias = #{normalized} THEN 1.0 WHEN #{normalized} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.normalized_alias, '%') THEN 0.86 WHEN #{question} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.alias, '%') THEN 0.82 ELSE 0.65 END ) AS score FROM oag_attribute_aliases a JOIN oag_attributes attr ON attr.domain = a.domain AND attr.attribute_name = a.attribute_name WHERE a.domain = #{domain} AND ( a.normalized_alias = #{normalized} OR #{normalized} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.normalized_alias, '%') OR #{question} LIKE CONCAT('%', a.alias, '%') ) GROUP BY attr.object_type, a.attribute_name, attr.attribute_name_zh, attr.aliases_json ORDER BY score DESC LIMIT #{topK}

SELECT object_type AS objectType, attribute_name AS attributeName, attribute_name_zh AS attributeNameZh, aliases_json AS aliasesJson FROM oag_attributes WHERE domain = #{domain} AND attribute_name IN
#{name}

SELECT object_type AS objectType, object_id AS objectId, object_name AS objectName, aliases_json AS aliasesJson, params_json AS paramsJson FROM oag_objects WHERE domain = #{domain} AND object_id IN
#{objectId}

SELECT intent_name AS intentName, intent_name_zh AS intentNameZh, trigger_aliases_json AS triggerAliasesJson, default_attributes_json AS defaultAttributesJson, primary_skills_json AS primarySkillsJson, secondary_skills_json AS secondarySkillsJson, optional_skills_json AS optionalSkillsJson, required_params_json AS requiredParamsJson, fact_requirements_template_json AS factRequirementsTemplateJson FROM oag_intent_profiles WHERE domain = #{domain} AND enabled = 1

SELECT skill_id AS skillId, skill_name AS skillName, description AS description, target_object_type AS targetObjectType, input_params_json AS inputParamsJson, output_attributes_json AS outputAttributesJson, related_queries_json AS relatedQueriesJson, permission_scope AS permissionScope, provides_fact_types_json AS providesFactTypesJson, supported_subject_types_json AS supportedSubjectTypesJson, supported_attributes_json AS supportedAttributesJson, output_fact_schema_json AS outputFactSchemaJson, supported_constraints_json AS supportedConstraintsJson FROM oag_skill_capabilities WHERE domain = #{domain} AND enabled = 1
